capabilities: Chat with AI models in a native Obsidian pane
Attach the focused note as removable chat context
Stream and render assistant responses as Markdown
Load pi-coding-agent-compatible extensions from a vault-local directory
Store and connection-test API keys for multiple providers
disambiguation: Not the Pi CLI in a terminal; it bundles Pi's JavaScript runtime libraries and omits the pi binary, terminal UI, and CLI commands.
extras: Warns that extensions execute arbitrary code with the plugin's permissions and should only be installed if trusted; mobile is read-only by design (no extensions, slash commands, shell or write tools), and GitHub Copilot is desktop-only.
intentEvidence: resolves extensions the same way pi-coding-agent does, rooted at the vault-local agent directory
problem: Obsidian has no built-in agent chat, and the Pi coding agent normally requires a host-level CLI installation and binary rather than running inside the app.

relations.evidence: Note Pi resolves extensions the same way pi-coding-agent does, rooted at the vault-local agent directory

requires.name: provider API key (Google Gemini, Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Code, OpenAI, or OpenRouter)

summary: AI chat pane that embeds the Pi agent runtime in-process, with multi-provider model keys, note context, and vault-local Pi extensions.
